130874807.title: File:UBS AG headquarters , Paradeplatz 6, Zürich, Switzerland (Ank Kumar, Infosys Limited) 01.jpg

ImageDescription.value:
UBS AG (Union Bank of Switzerland)  headquarters at Paradeplatz 6, Zürich, Switzerland (Ank Kumar, Infosys Limited)
Built in 1917, the UBS headquarters underwent several refurbishments and were also expanded over time., After about 100 years, the building has been completely renovated and serves as UBS headquarters since its reopening in 2018.
